symptom: Make reports PH agent scenarios as status=paused while they remain logically isActive=true. At least five inspected high-cost agents still route every AI result directly to BG168 before returning the primary result, so recovery of team capacity could restore unnecessary paid learning traffic immediately.

rootCause: The stable-runner template structurally couples AI completion to optional team-learning dispatch. Materiality is decided only after BG168 has already been invoked, so healthy, no-action or verification-only results can still consume BG168 credits. Team-level pause currently masks rather than removes this topology.
failedApproaches: Treat status=paused as proof the agent is structurally disabled even when isActive=true.
Rely only on BG168 internal classification to save caller-side invocation cost.
Put a filter directly on the learning module while leaving primary ReturnData downstream, because non-material outcomes could lose their primary result.
Reactivate all agents together after capacity recovery and use production traffic as the first runtime proof.
Reduce useful agent sensing or business functionality globally merely to lower learning cost.
Persist or repeat secret-like runtime capability values in learning evidence.
preventionRules: Decide materiality before invoking BG168; internal BG168 classification cannot eliminate invocation cost already incurred.
Do not treat Make status=paused with isActive=true as a structural deactivation or completed fix.
Primary business/agent result delivery must be independent from optional learning dispatch.
NON_MATERIAL outcomes must call BG168 zero times and return the exact original primary result.
MATERIAL outcomes may call BG168 at most once and must still return the exact original primary result when learning fails.
Resume from capacity pause in controlled stages after caller guards and runtime evidence, never as a big-bang restoration.
Inventory every caller before declaring the template fixed; currently only five agents are confirmed by exact blueprint readback.
Never persist credential-, token- or capability-like runtime values in repository learning, logs or user-visible evidence.
Do not buy additional paid capacity autonomously to force runtime proof.

regressionContract.resumeGate: fail closed while any confirmed high-risk caller lacks caller-side materiality or required runtime evidence
